definitions.name: E2A.MAXOF
definitions.body: 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> its largest element, floored at 0 (0 for an empty Vector)

definitions.name: E2A.OR
definitions.body: NOT 'EB' BIND NOT EB AND NOT
definitions.note: a b -> a OR b (truth values, element-wise, Kleene)

definitions.name: E2A.RLE
definitions.body: G0D.RUNS [ 'ER' BIND ER 0 GET ER LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: numeric V -> run-length encoding: a Vector of [ value count ], one per maximal run, in order

definitions.name: E2A.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'EV' BIND EV EV G0D.SHIFT SUB 0 GT 0 [ 'EF' BIND 'EA' BIND EA 1 ADD 1 EF SELECT ] SCAN E2A.MAXOF
definitions.note: numeric V -> length of its longest stretch of strictly increasing adjacent values

definitions.name: E2A.DEDUPE
definitions.body: G0D.RUNS [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: numeric V -> V with each run of equal adjacent values collapsed to one value

definitions.name: E2A.SECOND
definitions.body: UNIQUE SORT -2 GET 'ES' BIND NIL ES ES NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: V -> its second-largest distinct value, or NIL when all values are equal

definitions.name: E2A.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'EV' BIND EV TALLY 'ET' BIND ET U1D.TOPKEY 'EK' BIND EK NIL ET EK GET 2 MUL EV LENGTH GT SELECT
definitions.note: V -> the value occupying more than half its positions, or NIL when none does

definitions.name: E2A.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'EN' BIND 1 EN RANGE [ G0D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer N -> ascending Vector of the primes <= N

definitions.name: E2A.BINARY
definitions.body: 'EN' BIND 0 EN 1 ADD RANGE [ 'EK' BIND 2 EK POW ] MAP REVERSE 'EP' BIND EN EP DIV FLOOR 'EQQ' BIND EQQ EQQ 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB EP [ EN GT NOT ] FILTER LENGTH -1 MUL TAKE STR JOIN
definitions.note: positive integer -> its base-2 digits as a String, no leading zeros

definitions.name: E2A.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'EN' BIND 1 EN 10 MUL 200 ADD RANGE EN [ 'EI' BIND 'EV' BIND 1 EV 2 DIV EV 3 MUL 1 ADD EV 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL EV EQ SELECT EV 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN 'ES' BIND EN 1 COLLECT ES CONCAT [ 1 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: positive integer (small) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1

definitions.name: E2A.DIGROOT
definitions.body: 1 SUB 'EM' BIND EM EM 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer -> its digital root

definitions.name: E2A.FIBS
definitions.body: 'EN' BIND 1 EN RANGE [ 1 1 ] [ 'EI' BIND 'EA' BIND EA EA -1 GET EA -2 GET ADD 1 COLLECT CONCAT ] FOLD
definitions.note: N>=1 -> Vector of Fibonacci numbers F(1)..F(N+2)

definitions.name: E2A.FIBINDEX
definitions.body: 'EN' BIND EN E2A.FIBS [ EN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer N -> smallest k with F(k) >= N

definitions.name: E2A.BRDEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'EC' BIND 1 -1 EC '(' EQ EC '[' EQ E2A.OR SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN E2A.MAXOF
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest number of brackets open at once

definitions.name: E2A.BRREDUCE
definitions.body: 'ES' BIND 0 ES CHARS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR RANGE ES [ 'EI' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> what remains after repeatedly deleting adjacent () and [] pairs

definitions.name: E2A.BALANCED
definitions.body: E2A.BRREDUCE '' EQ
definitions.note: bracket String -> TRUE when properly nested and matched

definitions.name: E2A.BALPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS 'EC' BIND 0 EC LENGTH RANGE [ 'EL' BIND EC EL TAKE JOIN E2A.BALANCED ] FILTER E2A.MAXOF
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix

definitions.name: E2A.UNMATCHED
definitions.body: E2A.BRREDUCE CHARS LENGTH
definitions.note: bracket String -> count of characters left after deleting matched pairs

definitions.name: E2A.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: V -> its non-NIL elements, in order

definitions.name: E2A.MEAN
definitions.body: 'EP' BIND EP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD EP LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: non-empty numeric V -> arithmetic mean

definitions.name: E2A.PMEAN
definitions.body: E2A.PRESENT E2A.MEAN
definitions.note: V with NILs -> mean of the present values

definitions.name: E2A.FILLED
definitions.body: 'EV' BIND EV EV E2A.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'EX' BIND 'EA' BIND EA EX EX NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: V with NILs -> each NIL replaced by the previous present value (leading NILs by the first present)

definitions.name: E2A.MISSING
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP
definitions.note: V -> Vector of truths, TRUE where the element is NIL

definitions.name: E2A.GAPCOUNT
definitions.body: E2A.MISSING 'EM' BIND FALSE 1 COLLECT EM -1 DROP CONCAT NOT EM AND [ ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: V with NILs -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

definitions.name: E2A.LONGGAP
definitions.body: E2A.MISSING 0 [ 'EF' BIND 'EA' BIND EA 1 ADD 0 EF SELECT ] SCAN E2A.MAXOF
definitions.note: V with NILs -> length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 if none)

definitions.name: E2A.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'EV' BIND EV 1 DROP EV -1 DROP DIV
definitions.note: V -> each element divided by the one before (NIL where either is NIL), one shorter

definitions.name: E2A.SCALED
definitions.body: 'EV' BIND EV E2A.PRESENT 'EP' BIND EV EP EP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV
definitions.note: V with NILs -> each present value divided by the largest present value, NILs kept

definitions.name: E2A.REVENUE
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'EO' BIND EO 'qty' GET EO 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over orders having a price

definitions.name: E2A.QTYBY
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'EO' BIND EO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP EO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'EG' BIND EG KEYS EG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty, skus in first-appearance order

definitions.name: E2A.UNPRICED
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> distinct skus of orders without a price, first-appearance order

definitions.name: E2A.TAGCOUNTS
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record tag -> number of orders carrying it

definitions.name: E2A.LWORDS
definitions.body: LOWER G0D.WORDS
definitions.note: String -> Vector of its non-empty space-separated words, lower-cased

definitions.name: E2A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'EC' BIND EC 0 GET UPPER EC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case
